closures_since_v6.finding: Main article retrieved via the institutional ORIGINAL bundle; the sole listed publisher supplement was retrieved via its current browser link and examined. The supplement contains 6 pages, figures S1–S11, showing distance and normalization results. It provides no raw manifest, wavelength medium, specimen region or session mapping.

The author-site route yielded 28 JVrabel repositories and 9 PavelNedelnik repositories. Relevant current trees, branches, forks and six source-only notebooks were inspected; no BAM310 raw URL or acquisition map was found. Relevance is inferred from project names and code, not asserted as a publication-designated source of truth.

closures_since_v6.finding: The initial HTTP 403 was resolved using an ordinary anonymous public-link cookie session. The metadata API lists four files associated with ChemCam; it does not identify a BAM310 manifest. None of the listed files was downloaded.

The habilitation embeds article C6JA00322B (2016), not the 2025 article D4JA00377B. PDF page 174 describes BAM310 among aluminium CRMs: 3 µm and 1 µm diamond polishing, an ethanol wipe, 200 shots with one pulse per spot, and a 200 µm step. The aluminium settings table gives 50 mJ, a 1.5 µs delay and a 50 µs gate. It does not locate craters within the region covered by the BAM certificate or link these records to the 2025 sessions and files.
closures_since_v6.identity_relation: Unknown. Do not transfer the historical preparation procedure to the 2025 data or assume an independent physical disk.

closures_since_v6.finding: The official Catalina FAQ describes EMU120/65 Hg/Ar three-point KestrelCal calibration with reference values including 253.652 nm and 811.531 nm; KestrelSpec export and DLL options are documented. The inspected manufacturer pages and LIBSoft manual do not establish the actual calibration file, selected line convention or post-export conversion used for the 2025 BAM data. Do not infer the measured-axis medium from the atmosphere or default reference values alone.

domain_note: A different instrument alone would permit a separately preregistered campaign using fixed weights and thresholds, with explicitly limited out-of-domain claims. The within-domain guard must not be silently bypassed. BAM310 is not blocked solely by the instrument difference.
required_next_existing_records: A licensed FeAl dataset manifest with BAM310 filenames and checksums.
An existing laboratory record linking the BAM310 disk, prepared certified region, spot coordinates and measurement sessions to those files.
The actual instrument calibration or export record specifying air or vacuum wavelengths and any conversion.
Material, family, session and assay identifiers sufficient to check overlap with the history of previously seen records.
